def transform(grid):
    # Find the full-width divider separating the two panels. The rare color
    # in each panel is its signal; coincident signal cells become 3, and the
    # shared panel-background color fills the rest of the output.
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(
        i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
        if len(set(row)) == 1
        and sum(cell == row[0] for line in grid for cell in line) == w
    )
    upper = grid[:sep]
    lower = grid[sep + 1:]

    upper_counts = Counter(cell for row in upper for cell in row)
    lower_counts = Counter(cell for row in lower for cell in row)
    upper_signal = min(upper_counts, key=upper_counts.get)
    lower_signal = min(lower_counts, key=lower_counts.get)
    shared_colors = set(upper_counts) & set(lower_counts)
    background = (upper_signal if upper_signal == lower_signal
                  else next(iter(shared_colors)))

    return [
        [3 if upper[r][c] == upper_signal and lower[r][c] == lower_signal
         else background for c in range(w)]
        for r in range(min(len(upper), len(lower)))
    ]
